# Droplet-based single-cell RNA sequencing

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Allon M. Klein, Linas Mazutis, Ilke Akartuna, Naren Tallapragada, Adrian Veres, Vahid Li, Marc Peshkin, David A. Weitz, Marc W. Kirschner  
**Year:** 2018  
**Journal:** Nature  
**DOI:** [10.1038/nature14383](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature14383)  
**Publisher:** [https://www.nature.com/articles/nature14383](https://www.nature.com/articles/nature14383)

**Keywords:** drop-seq, single-cell

## Abstract

We describe a highly parallel and low cost method for single-cell RNA sequencing.
